source.citation: Kyriakou, Brignone and Fusai (2024), Unified moment-based modelling of integrated stochastic processes, Operations Research 72(4), 1630-1653
source.mapping: paper k -> kappa, theta -> variance theta, lowercase v -> sigma, uppercase V(0) -> initial variance; canonical slow factor first

cases.classification: study-defined sensitivity case, NOT a published parameter set: DH1 kappa_f multiplied by 3
study-defined sensitivity case, NOT a published parameter set: both DH1 sigmas multiplied by 0.5

excluded.reason: Both factors violate strict Feller condition. Preserve exact values, do not clip or train under incompatible constraints.

protocol.initialization: same seed-specific generic perturbation for every case; never centered on truth
protocol.selection: final fixed-budget checkpoint, report all seeds, no truth-based or holdout-based selection
protocol.scope: development pilot; synthetic surfaces, not NSE data or unseen market evidence; multi-expiry grid is a study adaptation, not the paper's original one-year test
